title: My, Your, His and Her
rules: Use my for the speaker and your for the listener.
Use his, her, our and their before a noun.

examples.question: This is ___ pencil. It belongs to me.
steps: Use my before something belonging to the speaker.

examples.question: That is ___ hat. It belongs to you.
steps: Use your for the person you are speaking to.

exercises.question: This is ___ pencil. It belongs to me.
exercises.solution: Use my before something belonging to the speaker.

exercises.question: That is ___ hat. It belongs to you.
exercises.solution: Use your for the person you are speaking to.

exercises.question: Ben uses he. This is ___ shirt.
exercises.solution: His shows possession for someone using he.

exercises.question: Aina uses she. This is ___ dress.
exercises.solution: Her shows possession for someone using she.

exercises.question: We own the ball. It is ___ ball.
exercises.solution: Our shows that something belongs to us.

exercises.question: They own the books. These are ___ books.
exercises.solution: Their shows that something belongs to them.

summary: Show who something belongs to. Use my for the speaker and your for the listener.
